allow_users.description: List of usernames permitted to use the 'at' command. If non-empty, only these users may submit jobs, and /etc/at.deny is ignored.

items.description: A username allowed to submit delayed jobs.

deny_users.description: List of usernames explicitly forbidden from using the 'at' command. Ignored if /etc/at.allow exists (i.e., if allow_users is non-empty).

items.description: A username denied from submitting delayed jobs.
